splash_page.title: Welcome to RockTheVote!
splash_page.body:
This app will help you through all the steps to be ready to vote, and to help your friends and family too.

The first steps are to check whether you are registered to vote, get you registered if needed, and then show your options for next steps to getting fully vote-ready.

initial_profile_page.title: Check Your Voter Registration
initial_profile_page.retry_body: To re-try your voter registration lookup, correct any of the information below. If the information already looks right, choose Register to Vote below.
initial_profile_page.some_data_body: Please check the information about you listed below: confirm, correct, or complete the information that we will use to check your voter registration.
initial_profile_page.no_data_body: Please fill out all the fields below, so that we can check whether you need to register to vote.

onboarding2.title: Finish Your Voter Profile
onboarding2.body: There are just a few more items to complete your profile.
onboarding2.comm_preferences_body1: You can receive notifications of three kinds, and customize which ones.
onboarding2.comm_preferences_type1: Changes to your voter registration status, and availability of sample ballot and voting place information.
onboarding2.comm_preferences_type2: Upcoming election dates and deadlines that you might need to act on.
onboarding2.comm_preferences_type3: Other information alerts and actions to help you assist friends and family.
onboarding2.comm_preferences_body2: You will receive your selected notifications via this app’s notifications on your device’s notification screen . You can also choose:
onboarding2.comm_preferences_option_sms: Receive notifications also via text messages

dashboard.title: Your Voter Status Dashboard
dashboard.returning: Welcome back, {{firstname}}! Check everything you need to get completely vote-ready.
dashboard.finished_onboarding: Thanks, {{firstname}}! Below you’ll find everything you need to know to get completely vote-ready.
dashboard.location_prompt: See your <locationLink>Voting Map</locationLink> for options to vote in person, early, or ballot drop-off
dashboard.abr_prompt: You may be eligible to vote absentee or by mail -- <abrLink>Check Your Options</abrLink>

restart.title: Restart
restart.body: Welcome back! You haven’t finished the onboarding needed to use this app. Please continue the on-boarding process.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.body: Please update any of your personal information below that has changed
profile.change_notice: Because of your changes, you’ll need to update your voter registration by continuing below.
